name: Princess Kingdom
release_name: Active-player scoreboard and failed-team turn handoff
changes: Moved the active-player indicator into the existing scoreboard panel position. When multiple profiles exist, the active player is shown there; Team Mode keeps its team scores in the same panel and also shows the active profile.
In Team Mode, replaced the skip button label with “Nu am reușit”. Using it advances to the next team and next challenge without awarding a point to the team that could not complete the challenge.
Kept the existing V51 profile data, challenge banks, Princess artwork references, and saved progress. Princess artwork is intentionally omitted from this update archive.
